summary: The customer called to inquire about a refund for a cancelled order. The agent checked the system, explained the standard timeframe of three to five business days, and promised a follow-up with the billing department. The customer was satisfied and the call ended politely.

evidence.text: أنا رح أعملك follow-up مع الـ billing department.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Follow up with the billing department regarding the refund status.

evidence.text: ولا مهتم، أكيد بشيكلك على الموضوع.
evidence.speaker: Agent

compliance_flags.description: The agent used an unprofessional and colloquial dismissive phrase at the beginning instead of standard professional acknowledgement.

evidence.text: ولا مهتم، أكيد بشيكلك على الموضوع.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent started with an inappropriate phrase, though the rest of the conversation was polite.

evidence.text: بس عشان أطمنك أكتر، أنا رح أعملك follow-up مع الـ billing department.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent showed genuine care by offering to follow up to reassure the customer.

evidence.text: غالباً بكره أو بعد بكره بالكثير بيكونوا بالحساب.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained the timeframe clearly and gave a realistic expectation.

evidence.text: عادةً الـ refund بتاخد من ثلاث لـ خمس أيام عمل لتبان بالحساب.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The explanation regarding refund timeframes was clear and easy to understand.

evidence.text: الله يعافيك، يوماً سعيداً، مع السلامة.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent wrapped up the call nicely, asked if anything else was needed, and said goodbye.

evidence.text: السستم عم بيحكي إنه الـ cancellation تمت بنجاح، بس المصاري لسه ما رجعوا عالحساب؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent correctly accessed the system and provided accurate information about the cancellation and refund policy.

evidence.text: شو رقم الأردن Order number لو سمحت؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent asked for the order number but missed a formal identity verification step before discussing account details.

quote.text: أنا بدي أستفسر عن refund لطلب أنا عملته وصارله cancel.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: آه تمام، يعني إحنا لسه ضمن الـ timeframe؟
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: ممتاز، الله يجزيك الخير على مساعدتك.
quote.speaker: Customer
